name: Basilisks: Should Petrification be Feared?
summary: A librarian asks you to bring magical works that could enrich the library’s collection. Your discoveries help expand its knowledge.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: The librarian thanks you for adding to the collection. Your efforts bring new knowledge to the library, and further magical works may be welcome there.

faq.answer: The librarian welcomes magical works that might benefit the collection.
The librarian says they can benefit the library and expand its knowledge.

faq.q: What happens when I bring something?
faq.answer: The librarian thanks you, saying your efforts expand the library’s knowledge.
